projects.name: ESI-Curvature Modeling of Egg Trajectories: Morphological Effects (Independent Research)
projects.summary: Built a controlled 2.87-degree rolling platform and collected static images of 90 eggs with three trials each (270 videos). Extracted morphology and motion descriptors; vision-based ESI showed 0.788% mean relative error against manual measurement. Constructed a motion-based RSI using PCA and K-means and compared four classifiers. The final thesis reports SVM accuracy of 74.07% and macro F1 of 81.64%, while gradient boosting achieved the highest macro AUC (86.65%). Results use a trial-level split; independent-egg validation remains a next step. Developed the companion Egg_RSI_App research demonstration.
highlights: Provincial-level Innovation & Entrepreneurship Training Program — Excellent completion

projects.name: Machine Vision for Coupled Egg Dynamics & Intelligent Sorting (Leader)
projects.summary: Led and supervised a four-member team in machine-vision-based egg analysis and sorting theses: developed kinematic time-series extraction (centroid, attitude, velocity, acceleration), coupled static morphology with dynamic rolling for risk prediction via a PCA-based rolling stability index, trained four ML classifiers with SVM leading on reported accuracy (74.07%, trial-level split of 270 videos from 90 eggs), clustered trajectories into three stability classes via GMM, and built multi-species egg classifiers from fused HSV and LBP features (8 species, 713 images; KNN 99.30%).
highlights: Graduation thesis project of a four-member group, completed successfully

projects.name: Research on Multi-Object Localization of Rocket Debris (Independent Research)
projects.summary: Developed a numerical sonic-boom source localization workflow using approximate WGS84-based coordinate preparation, nonlinear least squares (MATLAB lsqnonlin), and a search over 256 arrival-time combinations with feasibility filtering. Studied four-source association and sensitivity to recording noise with a 0.5 s standard deviation; the results estimate airborne boom positions, not validated landing points.
highlights: Published in Frontier and Progress of Computational Mathematics and Modeling (December 2024, no. 6)

projects.name: Various Mathematical Modeling Competitions (Leader; Independent Research)
projects.summary: Led teams or worked independently on competition papers: the 2024 Certified Cup Challenge (finite-element skull model based on the Ogden constitutive model), the 2024 CUMCM (helical coiling dragon simulation via polar-angle iteration and Simpson's rule), and the 2025 CUMCM (multi-objective UAV smoke-screen jamming simulation optimized by particle swarm with dual-plane projection occlusion modeling).
highlights: First-class awards at both national and provincial levels
